{{4icons|Worker Elephant}} |Wood = 50 |Gold = 150 |Time = 90 seconds |Stats = Villager carry capacity +5, movement speed +15% |Civilization = All except [[Japanese (Age of Empires IV)|Japanese]] and [[Sengoku Daimyo]] }} '''[[Wikipedia:Wheelbarrow#Medieval Europe|Wheelbarrow]]''' is an economic [[Technology (Age of Empires IV)|technology]] in ''[[Age of Empires IV]]'' that can be researched at any dedicated food drop-off site or various landmarks starting in the [[Dark Age (Age of Empires IV)|Dark Age]]. Once researched, it increases the carry capacity of [[Villager (Age of Empires IV)|Villagers]] by 5 and their movement speed by 15%. It is available to all civilizations, except the [[Japanese (Age of Empires IV)|Japanese]] and [[Sengoku Daimyo]]. == Civilization bonuses == * {{4icons|Abbasid Dynasty}}: If [[Preservation of Knowledge]] has been researched, this technology costs -20%. * {{4icons|Ayyubids}}: Research speeds are 25% faster while Golden Age tier 2 is active * {{4icons|Byzantines}}: Research speeds are 30% faster per water level at buildings within the influence of a [[Cistern]] with the Dialecticus ability active. * {{4icons|Chinese}} and {{4icons|ZXL}}: The technology researches 150% faster when the [[Mill (Age of Empires IV)|Mill]] or [[Granary (Age of Empires IV)|Granary]] is supervised by an Imperial Official. For Zhu Xi's Legacy, this can be improved to 300% faster after researching [[Regional Inspection]]. * {{4icons|Delhi Sultanate}}: The technology is free, but takes 3x as long to research (270 seconds instead of 90 seconds). * {{4icons|French}} and {{4icons|Jeanne d'Arc}}: Economic technologies are {{tt|35%|30% before patch 11.1.1201}} cheaper. * {{4icons|HoL}}: This technology is 20% cheaper if [[King's College]] has been constructed. * {{4icons|Malians}}: Technologies take less time to research based on how much gold has been obtained through trade. * {{4icons|Mongols}}: Can research the improved technology for an additional {{Resources|stone = 200}} to further improve Villager carry capacity by +4 (+9 total). * {{4icons|Tughlaq Dynasty}}: This technology researches in 5 seconds, but is 20% more expensive. Appointing the [[Governor of Uch]] reduces research costs by 15%/20%/25%/35% depending on the level of the [[Tughlaqabad Fort]]. == Changelog == * Originally, the base research time for the Delhi Sultanate was 5x default (450 seconds). With [[update 8324]], this was reduced to 3x default. * With [[update 24916]], Wheelbarrow is now available in the Granary. * Originally, Improved Wheelbarrow increased the maximum number of resources by an additional +2. With [[patch 9.2.628]], this was increased to +4. == Trivia == * The Wheelbarrow icon depicts a medieval European [https://bloodandsawdust.com/Blood_and_Sawdust/Building_a_16th_Century_Wheelbarrow.html fenced wheelbarrow]. == Campaign version == Because the original four campaigns have not been rebalanced since the release of the game, Wheelbarrow has different stats in those campaigns: * It costs {{resources|gold = 150}} and takes 45 seconds to research * The Mongol improved version costs an additional {{Resources|stone = 150}} {{Technology list (Age of Empires IV)}} [[Category:Economic technologies]]
